incident_time: 14:35 The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Alleged breach of Article 33.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and Article 12.2.1 i) of the FIA International Sporting Code (non-compliance with the Race Director's Event Notes, item 2, document 12)
reason: The Stewards thoroughly reviewed Marshalling/Positioning data, timing data, on- board cameras and CCTV cameras. All drivers concerned stayed at or above speeds necessary to stay below 1:55.0 around the vast majority of the circuit. However, the Stewards determine that all drivers concerned did not drive "unnecessarily slowly", and therefore take no further action.
